wikibasebootstrap-desc: Validates and applies bootstrap properties to Wikibase instances without active properties
ontologybootstrap-summary: Set up a Wikibase with a small, reviewed foundation of properties. You can create these properties only when Wikibase has no active properties. Nothing changes until you explicitly confirm it.
ontologybootstrap-invalid-token: Your session token was invalid. Please try again.
ontologybootstrap-not-empty: This Wikibase has active properties and cannot be bootstrapped. Reset its properties first; bootstrap properties are never merged into existing property data.
ontologybootstrap-existing-summary: You can only bootstrap a Wikibase without active properties.
ontologybootstrap-reset-invitation: It looks like your Wikibase is still relatively small with only $1 {{PLURAL:$1|property|properties}}. To create the bootstrap properties, you need to first delete all existing Wikibase properties.
ontologybootstrap-existing-warning: If you'd like to delete all of your current properties, you can do so below. Items, wiki pages, user accounts, and deletion history will not be deleted.
ontologybootstrap-complete: Bootstrap applied successfully: $1 properties were created.
ontologybootstrap-reset-permission: You do not have permission to reset Wikibase properties.
ontologybootstrap-reset-confirm-intro: To delete all of your existing Wikibase $1 properties, type:
ontologybootstrap-reset-confirm-required: Type DELETE $1 PROPERTIES exactly before deleting this batch.
ontologybootstrap-reset-progress: Deleted up to $1 properties. $2 active properties remain; repeat the confirmed reset if needed.
ontologybootstrap-reset-too-many: Ontology bootstrapping is only available for a Wikibase without active properties. To protect this existing Wikibase, its properties cannot be reset here once it contains more than $1 properties.
ontologybootstrap-reset-item-statements: These properties cannot be reset here because existing items have statements that use Wikibase properties.
ontologybootstrap-ready-to-apply: This Wikibase has no active properties and is eligible. Create $1 bootstrap properties.
ontologybootstrap-completion-description: $1 {{PLURAL:$1|property was|properties were}} created. Bootstrap setup is complete.
ontologybootstrap-apply-confirmation: This will create $1 {{PLURAL:$1|property|properties}} in a Wikibase without active properties. You cannot create them again while active properties exist.
